technical.summary: Bullish structure with price above all key MAs, positive momentum (OBV, force index, CMF), and Hull MA flip-up, but conflicting MACD signals and overbought Williams %R create mixed conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MKC shows minimal fundamental momentum with no insider activity, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, negligible lobbying, and approaching earnings in 60 days creating elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and stale (oldest trade 942 days ago), limiting conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (367.2) dominates; FOMC event just passed (-2 days); normal yield curve provides limited offset; 60-day earnings window adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with Hull MA flip-up, positive OBV/force index momentum, and extreme market fear (35/100) creating contrarian buy opportunity in oversold regime.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (367.2), conflicting MACD signals (histogram negative despite 8/21/5 crossover), overbought Williams %R, zero fundamental conviction, no active strategy triggers, and 60-day earnings risk outweigh technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows price above major MAs with Hull flip-up and positive momentum, but this is offset by conflicting MACD histogram, overbought Williams %R, and zero fundamental conviction in a VIX crisis regime.
